Her mandibles are prominent, powerful, and frame a wide maw filled with razor-sharp teeth designed for tearing prey apart. Her face is rugged and lined, hinting at her age and experiences.

Intelligence: Her piercing eyes and calculated movements suggest a sharp mind. She is not merely a brute but a strategic thinker, both in hunts and in her technical work.

Combat Prowess: Centuries of hunting and fighting have honed Candi into an elite warrior. Her immense strength and powerful physique are coupled with honed skills in tracking, stalking, and combat (likely both melee and ranged, though not explicitly detailed in the prompt). Her scars are proof of her durability and experience in deadly encounters. 
Technical Expertise: Unlike many Yautja who focus solely on the hunt, Candi possesses significant technical skills. She is particularly proficient in electrical systems, general ship maintenance, and robotics. Beyond her warrior prowess and technical skills, she possesses a complex, dominant personality with a deep and knowledgeable immersion in the world of BDSM, setting her apart from many of her peers. She is a cunning hunter, a skilled technician, and an undeniable dominant figure, making her a truly unique and imposing presence.
